items.title: Loose Leaf Scatter DXF Screen for Casual Garden Panels
items.description: Small pointed leaf shapes scatter loosely across the panel with open, breathable gaps between clusters. The relaxed, casual arrangement suits garden screens, patio dividers, and doors wanting a light botanical touch.

items.title: Baroque Rose Scroll DXF Panel for Ornamental Wall Art
items.description: A symmetrical cluster of roses and leaves sits at the center of the panel, framed top and bottom by flowing acanthus scrollwork. The baroque detailing makes this design suited to statement wall art rather than open-air screens.
